name: Drive a screw by hand
short_description: Select a matching hand driver and seat one screw flush without damaging the fastener.
self_assessment: I can drive one screw flush by hand without help or damaging its head.
description: Select a matching hand driver and seat one screw flush without damaging the fastener. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Fasten two pieces of scrap material
safety_note: Tools and sharp fasteners can injure hands or eyes; secure the work, use the matching driver, and keep the tool aligned.
